label: Beta cell
note: Inside an endocrine object. A cell is endocrine when a hormone, read over its own background in the image, clears the image's hormone level (the ordinary-tissue p99, lowered inside the objects to a 10% local false-discovery rate); it is named by its unique highest hormone on the cohort scale, here insulin. A Single's one cell is named by its unique highest hormone.

label: Alpha cell
note: As Beta cell, with glucagon the unique highest hormone.

label: Delta cell
note: As Beta cell, with somatostatin the unique highest hormone.

label: Endocrine
note: Endocrine cell without a unique highest hormone (tied, or not every hormone measured). Counted in every total; not listed as a phenotype beside Beta, Alpha and Delta.

label: CD8a Tcell
note: Immune T cell (CD3e >= 0.10 scaled, no epithelial marker) with Senior's T-CD8 subtype.

label: CD4 Tcell
note: Immune T cell with Senior's T-CD4-helper subtype.

label: T cell
note: T cell (CD3e >= 0.10 on the cohort scale, no epithelial marker) without a CD4 or CD8 subtype. Counted in every total; not listed beside CD8a and CD4 T cells.

label: Macrophage
note: Senior's Imm-macrophage (includes its Mac-M2-like subtype: CD163 with LGALS3).

label: Immune
note: CD45-positive leukocyte that no rule names further on this panel (owner rule, 2026-10-16), or Senior's supporting tier (a bottom-tier immune marker >= 0.8715 on the cohort scale). Counted in every total; not listed as a phenotype.

label: Blood Vessel
note: Only inside a Capillary object: centroid inside, more than half the cell inside, CD31 clears the image's level and is the cell's top expressed marker.

label: Neural
note: Only inside a Nerve object, by the same rule on B3TUBB.

label: Lymphatic
note: Only inside a Lymphatic object, by the same rule on PDPN.

label: Exocrine
note: Every other cell outside the endocrine objects: Senior's residual class (acinar, ductal and stromal cells are not separated). Exocrine inside an endocrine object is Excluded from analysis.
